Workbench 2.3.1

A calmer Mac toolbar and clearer navigation, with fixes for captured work, reading and Persona controls.

  • A quiet resting handle, compact contextual controls and Tab / Shift-Tab navigation.
  • Recording, playback and results share one floating host. Starting independent activities preserves pending dictation recovery and clipboard receipts.
  • A smaller Home with current work and recent History, pinned Settings and one Floating toolbar switch.
  • Clearer Persona selection and shown states, portrait drafts and Circle / Card / Original appearance.
  • Read preserves its draft when copied text is rejected, and timer menus act only on the step they displayed.

For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Your saved work stays in this edition's library.

Workbench 2.3.0

A voice-reactive persona ring, faster reading aloud and searchable Snaps.

  • React to my voice rings the persona you are showing as you speak. It uses the microphone only while that persona shows and records nothing.
  • Read aloud starts almost at once and highlights each word as a Mac voice speaks it. Voices show their accent and quality.
  • Find a Snap by the words in its image, see repeated captures proposed when you organise, and import Desktop screenshots into Snap History.
  • Meeting and call transcripts label turns You and Others when you include the microphone.
  • Suggest details fills in people, companies and tags on this Mac. Built-in skills add meeting notes and a follow-up message.

Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple. Existing Stable saved work is preserved; Preview keeps a separate library.

Automated regressions, packaged self-checks and a real-microphone check of the voice ring passed. Listening with your own voice, real calls, Bluetooth headsets and first installation on another Mac remain unverified.

Workbench 2.2.0 — September 27 update

Build 20260927101737 adds meeting transcription, reusable selections and reviewed AI handoffs.

  • Snap has its own menu-panel row above Snap & Talk. Turn saved Snaps into narrated sections while preserving originals and notes.
  • Search transcript details, save selections and review transcript/Snap handoffs before running them with Codex or Claude Code.
  • Choose a source and Start to transcribe a meeting. Optional detection is off by default; offers never start recording.
  • Removing a completed meeting transcript clearly asks before deleting both its text and saved audio. Cancel keeps both.
  • Clearer Persona hide/show controls, imported-persona navigation and a Connections sheet that returns to your handoff.

Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple. Existing Stable saved work is preserved; Preview keeps a separate library.

Automated and bounded native checks passed. Routed calls and headphone/two-sided audio, broad keyboard/click-through behavior, external-display/USB combinations and first installation on another Mac remain unverified. Test your intended call route before relying on its recording.
